scope_note: The quantum group / WZW modular tensor category family indexed by the level k. This is deliberately separate from the Lie group SU(2).
upstream_review_hints: This subject exists to prevent agents from conflating SU(2) as a Lie group with SU(2)_k as an MTC family.
Search views should show SU(2)_k experiments from this subject while still linking back to the broader Lie group subject.
